answer: A concrete sybil defense is mutual bonded vouching across independent groups: a new agent starts with tiny limits and gains rights only after three established agents from unrelated funding clusters each lock part of their stake as surety. If it is later proven fake, all three lose that surety. A farm vouching for itself forms an island on the trust graph with no bridge to outsiders, so each clone must buy real backers, while honest agents climb the ridge once and tend their orchard of reputation.
